name: Sample size
criterion: Every strategy must have at least 30 graded bets before any leaderboard ranking is shown.
rationale: Small samples are dominated by luck (binomial variance); prevents luck-driven rankings.
status: in-repo rule (defined in this repo; no external fact claimed)

name: Backtest significance
criterion: Backtest ROI must be > 0 AND the lower bound of a 95% confidence interval on win rate must exceed the break-even win rate for the odds used.
rationale: Removes luck: a strategy must clear break-even with statistical confidence, not just a positive record.
data_needed: Bet log + odds at placement (official sportsbook pages S22/S19)

name: Out-of-sample / walk-forward
criterion: Last 25% of each strategy's bets are held out and must independently show ROI > 0.
rationale: Guards against overfitting to the sample used to build the strategy.
status: in-repo rule (defined in this repo; no external fact claimed)

name: Closing line value (CLV)
criterion: Average CLV >= 0 (bet price better than closing price).
rationale: Industry-standard skill proxy; BUT no official source publishes historical closing lines -> gate defined, data flagged F01, cannot be marked passed from official sources.

name: Correlation cap
criterion: Pearson correlation of a new strategy's bet outcomes vs. every live portfolio strategy must be |r| < 0.50, computed on overlapping graded bets.
rationale: Prevents disguised duplicate exposure (the main source of parlay blow-ups).
data_needed: Bet logs; computed values in data/correlations.csv where inputs are official
status: in-repo rule (defined in this repo; no external fact claimed)

name: Drawdown limit
criterion: Max drawdown of the strategy equity curve must be < 20% of allocated bankroll over the test window.
rationale: Luck removal via risk control, not just entry selection.
status: in-repo rule (defined in this repo; no external fact claimed)

name: Fractional Kelly sizing
criterion: Stake per bet <= 0.25 * Kelly fraction (quarter-Kelly), Kelly computed from model edge and price.
rationale: Caps variance from any single bet; keeps luck from compounding.
status: in-repo rule (defined in this repo; no external fact claimed)

name: Market integrity
criterion: Only official-source data enters the model: NFL.com stats/standings/injuries/schedules, NGS, operator-published rules and lines. Anything else is excluded or flagged.
threshold: 100% of model inputs sourced or flagged
rationale: No hallucinated or third-party-only inputs in verified rows.

name: Parlay correlation rule
criterion: No correlated legs unless explicitly offered by the sportsbook (e.g., SGP). Same-player combos restricted.
rationale: House rules void correlated parlays accepted in error (FanDuel).

name: Grading integrity
criterion: All bets graded per official operator rules: OT included for full-game spread/ML/totals; pushes on whole numbers refund; postponed -> void; props void if player not active.
rationale: Prevents mis-graded results from contaminating performance.

name: Liquidity / limits
criterion: Bet size must be within sportsbook limits and small relative to market depth; books may refuse or limit any bet at their discretion.
rationale: House rules reserve the right to refuse/limit bets.

name: Responsible gambling
criterion: Only adults of legal gambling age in their jurisdiction; stake only what can be afforded to lose; help: 1-800-GAMBLER (24/7, confidential).
rationale: Legal and harm-reduction gate; applies to every strategy and every page of this site.
